title: Archive one active Project offline through the isolated Project browser

requirements.invariant: One explicit confirmation bound to the currently selected active Project and its observed revision archives that Project: cancel makes no call; changed selection, lifecycle or revision invalidates stale confirmation; accepted local evidence moves the stable Project from Active to Archived immediately, including offline.

Archive preserves every Project relationship and all transactions, Items, Spaces and budget allocations; the target mutation changes only Project lifecycle, revision and server update time plus immutable operation evidence, and it never deletes or mutates Client, category, note, attachment/media, Invoice or accounting/history data.

Archive is a distinct history-preserving command, not restore/unarchive, delete, rename, details edit, Client reassignment or media mutation; O-024/O-025 and O-023 remain unselected because those behaviors are absent.

The verified ProjectArchiveIntent, ProjectArchiveUseCase, ArchiveProjectCommand, expected-revision precondition, fingerprint, one-call dispatch, receipt validation, cancellation and stable failures remain sole semantic owners; this slice composes them without a lifecycle Boolean or alternate operation contract.

Without network, acceptance atomically records the immutable operation, insert-only archive command and separate local-only lifecycle overlay in the encrypted Principal/Account database; immediate directory/detail evidence remains explicitly partial and survives close/reopen until rejection or qualifying authoritative readback.

Pending Project creation precedes archive FIFO. Transient upload failure retains exact work; durable rejection removes only its archive overlay; applied optimism remains until matching applied evidence plus authoritative archived readback at projected revision or newer authority permits cleanup, and stale readback never clears or resurrects optimism.

The entire UInt64 expected revision remains exact command evidence without floating-point coercion. It must match the locked active Project revision; out-of-signed-range values cannot match physical rows, signed-bigint maximum cannot increment, and concurrent same-revision commands produce exactly one apply and one durable conflict. Rejection recovery requires refreshed current active evidence and an explicit new-OperationID retry; exact same-ID replay remains idempotent.

The trusted handler authenticates first, verifies exact actor, active Account membership and Project-management capability before subject/result disclosure, locks one Account/Project row, validates command/replay/lifecycle/revision, mutates only the allowed Project columns, and writes one immutable terminal result. Direct Project/result writes and unauthorized or cross-Account reads fail closed.

Archive submission derives from one exact current selected active Project detail presentation and its locally observed revision. Represented partial/stale or cached content remains usable offline; waiting, absence, unavailable, uncached failure, archived, mismatched or stale-selection evidence makes zero calls. Existing atomic segments, order, readiness, false-empty truth, selection generation and directory/detail drainage remain unchanged.

Work is confined to nine reserved leaves and exact frozen shared touchpoints in the isolated target worktree. When implementation adds runnable `.sql` CONFIG-CAB6A5DAD1C0, non-runnable `.sql.ready` CONFIG-062839A9903C must remain physically present as an inert retired marker with replacement evidence; the new identity must be registered by the authorized discovery-control touchpoint, discovered/classified/claimed, every test-owner path moved, and exactly one runnable pgTAP leaf plus the unchanged run-all command retained. It adds no restore/delete/rename/reassign/media mutation, new Project/child schema authority, new Sync stream, target MCP behavior, Auth choice, source transform, migration, hosted resource, Firebase change, production access, release or cutover authority; A-003/A-004 stay proposed.

items: Reuse the verified Project archive operation/use case unchanged; provider and app types do not cross into LedgerTargetCore.

project-archive-v1 binds exact Operation, Account, actor, Project, finite capture time, one same-Project UInt64 expected revision and SHA-256 fingerprint and contains no lifecycle Boolean or unrelated field.

The Core-only browser archive model first captures an exact Project/revision confirmation, revalidates it before dispatch, invalidates changed evidence, admits no cancelled confirmation, owns one stable ambiguous-retry submission identity and exposes bounded local operation truth without treating local evidence as authorization.

Physical Project revision remains positive signed bigint. Full UInt64 command evidence stays exact decimal/canonical JSON; values above signed maximum cannot match and signed maximum cannot increment.

The handler mutation set is only Project lifecycle active-to-archived, revision increment, server updated time and immutable terminal result. All other Project fields and every related row are preserved.

One private search-path-pinned handler authorizes before OperationID/Project disclosure, validates canonical bytes/fingerprint and exact revision, then locks one exact Account/Project row in deterministic result/Project lock order.

Exact replay returns the immutable result; changed/cross-command reuse cannot rebind. Missing, inactive, stale/future/out-of-range/exhausted revision and permanent validation cases yield bounded durable outcomes only after non-enumerating scope authorization.

One valid apply changes only lifecycle, revision and update time atomically with its result; same-revision concurrency yields one apply and one conflict, with no external I/O or child/relationship mutation.

Reuse active-membership Account-scoped Project/result SELECT policies. An active Project manager may archive; a restricted same-Account member retains existing authorized reads but cannot call archive or directly write.
Revoked, anonymous, actor-mismatched and cross-Account callers cannot enumerate or mutate Project/result rows. No direct Project UPDATE policy is added.
Membership/capability/Project/result predicates use indexed exact scope paths and stable auth evaluation is hoisted where applicable.
Reuse existing Account-scoped Project and immutable operation-result streams unchanged; archive command/overlay rows never enter download streams as authority.
Existing directory/detail queries merge one exact archive overlay without changing provider order, readiness, source exhaustiveness, relationship completeness or authorization semantics.
Real authenticated Sync authorization/eviction remains required before A-004 advances.

Add one local-only pending Project archive overlay and one insert-only archive command. Acceptance commits operation/command/overlay atomically in encrypted Account storage without updating synchronized rows.

Pending creation then archive dispatches FIFO; exact replay resolves before current-effective-revision validation; invalid/stale/already-archived bases create no rows. Directory/detail immediately project the archived lifecycle as partial across encrypted restart.

Transient failure retains work. Durable rejection removes only the exact overlay and exposes refreshed active evidence; applied optimism awaits exact archived or newer authoritative readback; stale readback cannot clear or resurrect it.
Archive operation observation, browser observations and runtime shutdown obey race-safe cancellation/join/drain and no post-stop/old-generation mutation.

Current active detail evidence derives an exact confirmation; cancel makes zero calls; changed selection/lifecycle/revision invalidates confirmation; all admissible unchanged offline states dispatch, all invalid/archived/stale-selection states make zero calls, simultaneous confirm makes one call, ambiguous retry is byte-identical, all six local states render, and conflict recovery requires refreshed evidence/new ID.
